lines.1: I greet her with a glance,
lines.2: then dash past Otome, the disciplinary committee chair on gate duty--
lines.6: 「Leo, your shirt is untucked again. Honestly, you're hopelessly sloppy.」
lines.7: As she says it, she tucks my shirt back into my pants. Otome treats me exactly the same at home and at school.
lines.13: 「Otome, Otome, look! My shirt's come untucked too...」
lines.14: 「Shinichi, they say sloppy clothes mean a sloppy mind. Straighten yourself up!」
lines.15: 「Hey! Don't stop there! The gate is no place for chatting!」
lines.16: Otome goes off to warn some other students.
lines.17: Looks like Otome's morning duties are far from over.
lines.26: Otome races like the wind toward the sound.
